viewDefs.camps_geometries:
WITH geometries AS (
         SELECT c.id,
            c.name AS camp_label,
            c.gis AS geom,
            p.name AS platform_name
           FROM camps c
             LEFT JOIN platforms p ON c.platform_id = p.id
        ), distinct_geom AS (
         SELECT p.start_point_id AS geom_id
           FROM plans p
        UNION
         SELECT p.end_point_id AS geom_id
           FROM plans p
        ), join_geoms AS (
         SELECT dg.geom_id,
            g.camp_label,
            g.platform_name,
            st_boundary(g.geom) AS geom
           FROM distinct_geom dg
             LEFT JOIN geometries g ON dg.geom_id = g.id
        ), explode_multilinestring AS (
         SELECT j.geom_id,
            j.camp_label,
            j.platform_name,
            COALESCE(line_dp.path[1], 1) AS polygon_no,
            line_dp.geom AS polygon_geom
           FROM join_geoms j,
            LATERAL st_dump(st_transform(st_simplifyvw(st_transform(j.geom, 32637), 4::double precision), 4326)) line_dp(path, geom)
        )
 SELECT camp_label,
    platform_name,
    polygon_no,
    st_asgeojson(polygon_geom) AS st_asgeojson
   FROM explode_multilinestring;
viewDefs.final_plan_view:
WITH trip_point AS (
         SELECT r.id,
            st_envelope(st_transform(st_buffer(st_transform(st_setsrid(st_makepoint(r.longitude, r.latitude), 4326), 32637), 50::double precision), 4326)) AS polygon_geom,
            st_setsrid(st_makepoint(r.longitude, r.latitude), 4326) AS point_geom,
            r.name,
            r.area AS district
           FROM residences r
        UNION ALL
         SELECT doa.id,
            doa.gis AS polygon_geom,
            st_centroid(doa.gis) AS point_geom,
            doa.name,
            NULL::character varying AS district
           FROM drop_off_areas doa
        UNION ALL
         SELECT c.id,
            c.gis AS polygon_geom,
            st_setsrid(st_makepoint(c.gate_lon, c.gate_lat), 4326) AS point_geom,
            c.name,
            NULL::character varying AS district
           FROM camps c
        ), parking AS (
         SELECT bw.id,
            bw.name,
            bw.gis AS geom
           FROM bus_warehouses bw
        UNION ALL
         SELECT p.id,
            p.name,
            p.gis AS geom
           FROM public.parking p
        ), master_plan AS (
         SELECT p.id AS plan_id,
                CASE
                    WHEN p.start_point_type::text = 'camp'::text THEN sp.name
                    WHEN p.end_point_type::text = 'camp'::text THEN ep.name
                    ELSE NULL::character varying
                END AS camp_label,
            p.number_of_buses,
            p.number_of_haj,
            p.number_of_late_haj,
            p.number_of_early_haj,
            p.residence_id,
            r.license_number,
            r.area AS district,
            p.get_parking_id,
            p.get_type_parking,
            getp.name AS get_parking_name,
            getp.geom AS get_parking_geom,
            p.set_parking_id,
            p.set_type_parking,
            setp.name AS set_parking_name,
            setp.geom AS set_parking_geom,
            p.start_point_id,
            sp.name AS start_point_name,
            p.start_point_type,
            sp.point_geom AS start_point_geom,
            sp.polygon_geom AS start_geom,
            p.end_point_id,
            ep.name AS end_point_name,
            p.end_point_type,
            ep.point_geom AS end_point_geom,
            ep.polygon_geom AS end_geom,
            st_asgeojson(st_reduceprecision(st_transform(st_simplifyvw(st_transform(p.path_gis, 32637), 50::double precision), 4326), 0.0001::double precision)) AS path_geom,
            p.owner_id,
            sc.office_number AS owner_office_number,
            c.name AS owner_company_name,
            pr.name AS timing_name,
            t.start_at AS timing_start_at,
            t.start_at_hijri AS timing_start_at_hijri,
            t.end_at AS timing_end_at,
            t.end_at_hijri AS timing_end_at_hijri,
            pt.name AS plan_type_name,
            pt.code AS plan_type_code,
            tt.name AS transport_type_name,
            p.entrance_id,
            e.name AS entrance_name,
            e.asm_code AS entrance_asm_code,
            st_geometryn(e.gis, 1) AS entrance_polygon,
            st_setsrid(st_makepoint(e.longitude, e.latitude), 4326) AS entrance_point_geom,
            pth.name AS internal_path_name,
            st_asgeojson(st_reduceprecision(st_transform(st_simplifyvw(st_transform(p.path_gis, 32637), 50::double precision), 4326), 0.0001::double precision)) AS internal_path_geom,
                CASE
                    WHEN p.start_point_type::text = 'camp'::text THEN p.start_point_id
                    WHEN p.end_point_type::text = 'camp'::text THEN p.end_point_id
                    ELSE NULL::uuid
                END AS camp_id,
            p.updated_at,
            p.created_at
           FROM plans p
             LEFT JOIN parking getp ON p.get_parking_id = getp.id
             LEFT JOIN parking setp ON p.set_parking_id = setp.id
             LEFT JOIN trip_point sp ON p.start_point_id = sp.id
             LEFT JOIN trip_point ep ON p.end_point_id = ep.id
             LEFT JOIN service_centers sc ON p.owner_id = sc.id
             LEFT JOIN service_companies c ON sc.company_id = c.id
             LEFT JOIN timing t ON p.timing_id = t.id
             LEFT JOIN periods pr ON t.period_id = pr.id
             LEFT JOIN plan_types pt ON p.plan_type_id = pt.id
             LEFT JOIN transport_types tt ON p.transport_type_id = tt.id
             LEFT JOIN entrances e ON p.entrance_id = e.id
             LEFT JOIN paths pth ON p.path_id = pth.id
             LEFT JOIN residences r ON p.start_point_id = r.id
        ), hajj_count_added AS (
         SELECT ad.haj_count AS allocated_haj,
            ac.haj_count AS residence_haj,
            ac.tarwia,
            ac.direct_taseed,
            mp.plan_id,
            mp.camp_label,
            mp.number_of_buses,
            mp.number_of_haj,
            mp.number_of_late_haj,
            mp.number_of_early_haj,
            mp.residence_id,
            mp.license_number,
            mp.district,
            mp.get_parking_id,
            mp.get_type_parking,
            mp.get_parking_name,
            mp.get_parking_geom,
            mp.set_parking_id,
            mp.set_type_parking,
            mp.set_parking_name,
            mp.set_parking_geom,
            mp.start_point_id,
            mp.start_point_name,
            mp.start_point_type,
            mp.start_point_geom,
            mp.start_geom,
            mp.end_point_id,
            mp.end_point_name,
            mp.end_point_type,
            mp.end_point_geom,
            mp.end_geom,
            mp.path_geom,
            mp.owner_id,
            mp.owner_office_number,
            mp.owner_company_name,
            mp.timing_name,
            mp.timing_start_at,
            mp.timing_start_at_hijri,
            mp.timing_end_at,
            mp.timing_end_at_hijri,
            mp.plan_type_name,
            mp.plan_type_code,
            mp.transport_type_name,
            mp.entrance_id,
            mp.entrance_name,
            mp.entrance_asm_code,
            mp.entrance_polygon,
            mp.entrance_point_geom,
            mp.internal_path_name,
            mp.internal_path_geom,
            mp.camp_id,
            mp.updated_at,
            mp.created_at
           FROM master_plan mp
             LEFT JOIN assign_camps ad ON mp.camp_id = ad.camp_id AND mp.owner_id = ad.service_center_id
             LEFT JOIN assign_residences ac ON mp.start_point_id = ac.residence_id AND mp.owner_id = ac.service_center_id
        )
 SELECT plan_id,
    camp_label,
    allocated_haj,
    number_of_buses,
    number_of_late_haj,
    number_of_early_haj,
    license_number,
    district,
    residence_haj,
    tarwia,
    direct_taseed,
    get_type_parking,
    get_parking_name,
    set_type_parking,
    set_parking_name,
    entrance_asm_code,
    entrance_name,
    st_astext(entrance_point_geom) AS entrance_point_geom,
    start_point_name,
    start_point_type,
    st_astext(start_point_geom) AS start_point_geom,
    end_point_name,
    end_point_type,
    st_astext(end_point_geom) AS end_point_geom,
    path_geom,
    internal_path_name,
    internal_path_geom,
    owner_company_name,
    owner_office_number,
    timing_name,
    timing_start_at,
    timing_start_at_hijri,
    timing_end_at,
    timing_end_at_hijri,
    plan_type_name,
    plan_type_code,
    transport_type_name
   FROM hajj_count_added h;
viewDefs.geography_columns:
SELECT current_database() AS f_table_catalog,
    n.nspname AS f_table_schema,
    c.relname AS f_table_name,
    a.attname AS f_geography_column,
    postgis_typmod_dims(a.atttypmod) AS coord_dimension,
    postgis_typmod_srid(a.atttypmod) AS srid,
    postgis_typmod_type(a.atttypmod) AS type
   FROM pg_class c,
    pg_attribute a,
    pg_type t,
    pg_namespace n
  WHERE t.typname = 'geography'::name AND a.attisdropped = false AND a.atttypid = t.oid AND a.attrelid = c.oid AND c.relnamespace = n.oid AND (c.relkind = ANY (ARRAY['r'::"char", 'v'::"char", 'm'::"char", 'f'::"char", 'p'::"char"])) AND NOT pg_is_other_temp_schema(c.relnamespace) AND has_table_privilege(c.oid, 'SELECT'::text);
viewDefs.geometry_columns:
SELECT current_database()::character varying(256) AS f_table_catalog,
    n.nspname AS f_table_schema,
    c.relname AS f_table_name,
    a.attname AS f_geometry_column,
    COALESCE(postgis_typmod_dims(a.atttypmod), sn.ndims, 2) AS coord_dimension,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(postgis_typmod_srid(a.atttypmod), 0), sr.srid, 0) AS srid,
    replace(replace(COALESCE(NULLIF(upper(postgis_typmod_type(a.atttypmod)), 'GEOMETRY'::text), st.type, 'GEOMETRY'::text), 'ZM'::text, ''::text), 'Z'::text, ''::text)::character varying(30) AS type
   FROM pg_class c
     JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.oid AND NOT a.attisdropped
     JOIN pg_namespace n ON c.relnamespace = n.oid
     JOIN pg_type t ON a.atttypid = t.oid
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.connamespace,
            s.conrelid,
            s.conkey,
            (regexp_match(s.consrc, 'geometrytype\(\w+\)\s*=\s*''(\w+)'''::text, 'i'::text))[1] AS type
           FROM ( SELECT pg_constraint.connamespace,
                    pg_constraint.conrelid,
                    pg_constraint.conkey,
                    pg_get_constraintdef(pg_constraint.oid) AS consrc
                   FROM pg_constraint) s
          WHERE s.consrc ~* 'geometrytype\(\w+\)\s*=\s*''\w+'''::text) st ON st.connamespace = n.oid AND st.conrelid = c.oid AND (a.attnum = ANY (st.conkey))
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.connamespace,
            s.conrelid,
            s.conkey,
            (regexp_match(s.consrc, 'ndims\(\w+\)\s*=\s*(\d+)'::text, 'i'::text))[1]::integer AS ndims
           FROM ( SELECT pg_constraint.connamespace,
                    pg_constraint.conrelid,
                    pg_constraint.conkey,
                    pg_get_constraintdef(pg_constraint.oid) AS consrc
                   FROM pg_constraint) s
          WHERE s.consrc ~* 'ndims\(\w+\)\s*=\s*\d+'::text) sn ON sn.connamespace = n.oid AND sn.conrelid = c.oid AND (a.attnum = ANY (sn.conkey))
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.connamespace,
            s.conrelid,
            s.conkey,
            (regexp_match(s.consrc, 'srid\(\w+\)\s*=\s*(\d+)'::text, 'i'::text))[1]::integer AS srid
           FROM ( SELECT pg_constraint.connamespace,
                    pg_constraint.conrelid,
                    pg_constraint.conkey,
                    pg_get_constraintdef(pg_constraint.oid) AS consrc
                   FROM pg_constraint) s
          WHERE s.consrc ~* 'srid\(\w+\)\s*=\s*\d+'::text) sr ON sr.connamespace = n.oid AND sr.conrelid = c.oid AND (a.attnum = ANY (sr.conkey))
  WHERE (c.relkind = ANY (ARRAY['r'::"char", 'v'::"char", 'm'::"char", 'f'::"char", 'p'::"char"])) AND NOT c.relname = 'raster_columns'::name AND t.typname = 'geometry'::name AND NOT pg_is_other_temp_schema(c.relnamespace) AND has_table_privilege(c.oid, 'SELECT'::text);

viewDefs.plan_show_view:
SELECT p.id,
    p.period,
    p.number_of_buses,
    p.number_of_haj,
    p.number_of_late_haj,
    p.number_of_early_haj,
    p.plan_type_id,
    p.transport_type_id,
    p.entrance_id,
    p.path_id,
    p.get_type_parking,
    p.get_parking_id,
    p.set_type_parking,
    p.set_parking_id,
    p.plan_desire_id,
    p.transport_company_id,
    p.start_point_type,
    p.start_point_id,
    p.end_point_type,
    p.end_point_id,
    p.owner_id,
    p.creator_id,
    p.timing_id,
        CASE
            WHEN p.path_gis IS NOT NULL THEN st_asgeojson(p.path_gis)::jsonb
            ELSE NULL::jsonb
        END AS path_gis,
    p.created_at,
    p.updated_at,
    creator.id AS creator_id_ref,
    creator.name AS creator_name,
    creator.email AS creator_email,
    creator.phone AS creator_phone,
    creator.is_active AS creator_is_active,
    creator.type_id AS creator_type_id,
    creator.company_id AS creator_company_id,
    creator.service_center_id AS creator_service_center_id,
    creator.created_by AS creator_created_by,
    creator.created_at AS creator_created_at,
    creator.updated_at AS creator_updated_at,
    owner_sc.id AS owner_service_center_id,
    owner_sc.center_name AS owner_center_name,
    owner_sc.office_number AS owner_office_number,
    owner_sc.company_id AS owner_company_id,
    owner_sc.created_by AS owner_created_by,
    owner_sc.created_at AS owner_created_at,
    owner_sc.updated_at AS owner_updated_at,
    owner_company.id AS owner_company_ref_id,
    owner_company.name AS owner_company_name,
    timing_tbl.id AS timing_ref_id,
    timing_tbl.plan_type_id AS timing_plan_type_id,
    timing_tbl.start_at AS timing_start_at,
    timing_tbl.start_at_hijri AS timing_start_at_hijri,
    timing_tbl.end_at AS timing_end_at,
    timing_tbl.end_at_hijri AS timing_end_at_hijri,
    timing_tbl.period_id AS timing_period_id,
    timing_tbl.created_at AS timing_created_at,
    timing_tbl.updated_at AS timing_updated_at,
    plan_type_tbl.id AS plan_type_ref_id,
    plan_type_tbl.name AS plan_type_name,
    plan_type_tbl.code AS plan_type_code,
    plan_type_tbl.created_at AS plan_type_created_at,
    plan_type_tbl.updated_at AS plan_type_updated_at,
    transport_type_tbl.id AS transport_type_ref_id,
    transport_type_tbl.name AS transport_type_name,
    transport_type_tbl.created_at AS transport_type_created_at,
    transport_type_tbl.updated_at AS transport_type_updated_at,
    entrance_tbl.id AS entrance_ref_id,
    entrance_tbl.name AS entrance_name,
    entrance_tbl.shape_area AS entrance_shape_area,
    entrance_tbl.shape_length AS entrance_shape_length,
    entrance_tbl.gis_data_type AS entrance_gis_data_type,
        CASE
            WHEN entrance_tbl.gis IS NOT NULL THEN st_asgeojson(entrance_tbl.gis)::jsonb
            ELSE NULL::jsonb
        END AS entrance_gis,
    entrance_tbl.longitude AS entrance_longitude,
    entrance_tbl.latitude AS entrance_latitude,
    entrance_tbl.asm_code AS entrance_asm_code,
    entrance_tbl.created_at AS entrance_created_at,
    entrance_tbl.updated_at AS entrance_updated_at,
    path_tbl.id AS path_ref_id,
    path_tbl.name AS path_name,
    path_tbl.objectid AS path_objectid,
        CASE
            WHEN path_tbl.gis IS NOT NULL THEN st_asgeojson(path_tbl.gis)::jsonb
            ELSE NULL::jsonb
        END AS path_relation_gis,
    path_tbl.created_at AS path_created_at,
    path_tbl.updated_at AS path_updated_at,
    plan_desire_tbl.id AS plan_desire_ref_id,
    plan_desire_tbl.name AS plan_desire_name,
    plan_desire_tbl.created_at AS plan_desire_created_at,
    plan_desire_tbl.updated_at AS plan_desire_updated_at,
    p.number_of_trips
   FROM plans p
     LEFT JOIN users creator ON creator.id = p.creator_id
     LEFT JOIN service_centers owner_sc ON owner_sc.id = p.owner_id
     LEFT JOIN service_companies owner_company ON owner_company.id = owner_sc.company_id
     LEFT JOIN timing timing_tbl ON timing_tbl.id = p.timing_id
     LEFT JOIN plan_types plan_type_tbl ON plan_type_tbl.id = p.plan_type_id
     LEFT JOIN transport_types transport_type_tbl ON transport_type_tbl.id = p.transport_type_id
     LEFT JOIN entrances entrance_tbl ON entrance_tbl.id = p.entrance_id
     LEFT JOIN paths path_tbl ON path_tbl.id = p.path_id
     LEFT JOIN plan_desires plan_desire_tbl ON plan_desire_tbl.id = p.plan_desire_id;
viewDefs.simulation_data_view:
WITH routing_points AS (
         SELECT r.id,
            st_transform(st_buffer(st_transform(st_setsrid(st_makepoint(r.longitude, r.latitude), 4326), 32637), 30::double precision), 4326) AS geom,
            r.name,
            'residence'::text AS source,
            r.area AS district
           FROM residences r
        UNION ALL
         SELECT bs.id,
            bs.gis AS geom,
            bs.name,
            'bus_stop'::text AS source,
            NULL::character varying AS district
           FROM bus_stops bs
        UNION ALL
         SELECT doa.id,
            doa.gis AS geom,
            doa.name,
            'dropoff'::text AS source,
            NULL::character varying AS district
           FROM drop_off_areas doa
        UNION ALL
         SELECT c.id,
            c.gis AS geom,
            c.name,
            'camp'::text AS source,
            NULL::character varying AS district
           FROM camps c
        ), parking AS (
         SELECT bw.id,
            bw.name,
            bw.gis AS geom
           FROM bus_warehouses bw
        UNION ALL
         SELECT p.id,
            p.name,
            p.gis AS geom
           FROM public.parking p
        ), plan AS (
         SELECT psv.id AS plan_id,
            c.name AS camp_label,
            ad.haj_count AS allocated_haj,
            psv.number_of_buses,
            psv.number_of_haj,
            psv.number_of_late_haj,
            psv.number_of_early_haj,
            psv.get_type_parking,
            getp.name AS get_parking_name,
            getp.geom AS get_parking_geom,
            psv.set_type_parking,
            setp.name AS set_parking_name,
            setp.geom AS set_parking_geom,
            sp.name AS start_point_name,
            psv.start_point_type,
            st_startpoint(st_geomfromgeojson(psv.path_gis::text)) AS start_point_geom,
            sp.geom AS start_geom,
            sp.district AS start_point_district,
            ep.name AS end_point_name,
            psv.end_point_type,
            st_endpoint(st_geomfromgeojson(psv.path_gis::text)) AS end_point_geom,
            ep.geom AS end_geom,
            psv.owner_id,
            st_geomfromgeojson(psv.path_gis::text) AS path_geom,
            psv.owner_office_number,
            psv.owner_company_name,
            p.name AS period,
            psv.timing_start_at,
            psv.timing_start_at_hijri,
            psv.timing_end_at,
            psv.timing_end_at_hijri,
            psv.plan_type_name,
            psv.plan_type_code,
            psv.transport_type_name,
            psv.entrance_name,
            st_geometryn(st_geomfromgeojson(psv.entrance_gis::text), 1) AS entrance_polygon,
            st_setsrid(st_makepoint(psv.entrance_longitude, psv.entrance_latitude), 4326) AS entrance_point_geom,
            psv.entrance_asm_code,
            psv.path_name,
            st_geomfromgeojson(psv.path_relation_gis::text) AS internal_path,
            psv.updated_at,
            psv.created_at
           FROM plan_show_view psv
             LEFT JOIN routing_points sp ON psv.start_point_id = sp.id
             LEFT JOIN routing_points ep ON psv.end_point_id = ep.id
             LEFT JOIN parking getp ON psv.get_parking_id = getp.id
             LEFT JOIN parking setp ON psv.set_parking_id = setp.id
             LEFT JOIN assign_camps ad ON psv.owner_service_center_id = ad.service_center_id
             LEFT JOIN camps c ON ad.camp_id = c.id
             LEFT JOIN periods p ON psv.timing_period_id = p.id
        )
 SELECT DISTINCT ON (plan_id, camp_label) plan_id,
    camp_label,
    allocated_haj,
    number_of_buses,
    number_of_haj,
    number_of_late_haj,
    number_of_early_haj,
    get_type_parking,
    get_parking_name,
    get_parking_geom,
    set_type_parking,
    set_parking_name,
    set_parking_geom,
    start_point_name,
    start_point_type,
    start_point_geom,
    start_geom,
    start_point_district,
    end_point_name,
    end_point_type,
    end_point_geom,
    end_geom,
    owner_id,
    path_geom,
    owner_office_number,
    owner_company_name,
    period,
    timing_start_at,
    timing_start_at_hijri,
    timing_end_at,
    timing_end_at_hijri,
    plan_type_name,
    plan_type_code,
    transport_type_name,
    entrance_name,
    entrance_polygon,
    entrance_point_geom,
    entrance_asm_code,
    path_name,
    internal_path,
    updated_at,
    created_at
   FROM plan
  ORDER BY plan_id, camp_label, updated_at DESC;
